situations.title: 마취 전 sign-in
situations.tagline: Before we induce, let's confirm the patient's identity, the site, and the consent together.
situations.brief: 입실 시 sign-in 항목을 팀과 함께 구두로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Patient's name and date of birth, please confirm.
Surgical site is marked and consent is signed.
Any known allergies before we induce?

situations.title: 절개 전 팀 정지
situations.tagline: Everyone pause — let's do our time-out before the first incision.
situations.brief: 절개 직전 전체 팀을 정지시키고 타임아웃을 개시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's stop and do our time-out now.
Can I have everyone's attention, please?
We won't start until we've all confirmed.

situations.title: 환자·부위·시술 재확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm out loud — right knee, arthroscopy, for John Miller.
situations.brief: 환자·부위·시술 3요소를 팀과 구두로 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Patient is John Miller, date of birth confirmed.
Procedure is a right knee arthroscopy.
The site is marked on the right knee — everyone agree?

situations.title: 팀원 역할 소개
situations.tagline: Let's go around and introduce ourselves and our roles before we start.
situations.brief: 팀 구성원의 이름과 역할을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm the circulating nurse for this case.
Let's make sure everyone knows their role.
Scrub tech, anesthesia, and surgeon — all set?

situations.title: 예방적 항생제 확인
situations.tagline: Confirm with me — were prophylactic antibiotics given within the last hour?
situations.brief: 절개 전 예방적 항생제 투여 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Antibiotics were given at the time noted, yes.
That was within the recommended window before incision.
I've documented the dose and time.

situations.title: 종료 sign-out
situations.tagline: Before we close, let's confirm the counts are correct and the specimen is labeled.
situations.brief: 수술 종료 시 sign-out 항목을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Instrument and sponge counts are correct.
The specimen is labeled and ready to send.
Any equipment concerns to address for recovery?

situations.title: 타임아웃 중 이견 제기
situations.tagline: Hold on — I'm not sure the consent matches the procedure we're about to do.
situations.brief: 타임아웃 중 우려를 제기하도록 발언을 권장하고 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for speaking up — let's stop and check.
Let's pull up the consent and confirm together.
No one starts until this is resolved.

situations.title: 영상 좌우 대조
situations.tagline: Can we confirm the imaging is showing the correct side before we position?
situations.brief: 영상 표지와 수술 부위의 좌우를 대조하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's verify the imaging matches the marked side.
The films are labeled left — does that match our plan?
I want everyone to confirm before we drape.
goals: 영상 표지와 수술 부위 좌우를 대조한다

situations.title: 예상 출혈·수혈 논의
situations.tagline: This case could bleed — do we have blood available and lines ready?
situations.brief: 예상 출혈과 수혈 위험을 사전에 팀과 공유하세요.
keyPhrases: We anticipate significant blood loss for this case.
Type and cross is done, and units are on hold.
I'll make sure large-bore access is in place.

situations.title: 이식물·특수 기구 확인
situations.tagline: Before we start, confirm the implant size and any special instruments are in the room.
situations.brief: 필요한 이식물과 특수 기구의 준비 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The implant is here and the size matches the plan.
All special instruments are open and ready.
Any equipment we still need to bring in?

situations.title: 알레르기 팀 공유
situations.tagline: Just reconfirming for the whole team — this patient has a latex allergy.
situations.brief: 환자의 알레르기를 타임아웃에서 팀 전체에 재고지하세요.
keyPhrases: This patient has a documented latex allergy.
Please confirm we're using latex-free supplies.
Let's all be aware before we proceed.

situations.title: 항생제 재투여 계획
situations.tagline: This is going to be a long case — when do we need to redose the antibiotics?
situations.brief: 장시간 수술 시 항생제 재투여 계획을 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: Based on the drug, redosing is due in a few hours.
I'll set a timer so we don't miss the redose.
Let me know if the case runs longer than planned.
goals: 장시간 수술의 항생제 재투여 시점을 계획한다

situations.title: 타임아웃 참여 저조
situations.tagline: A couple of people are still busy — I need everyone to stop and take part in this time-out.
situations.brief: 전원이 타임아웃에 참여하도록 유도하세요.
keyPhrases: I need everyone to pause and be present for this.
The time-out only works if we all participate.
Let's take thirty seconds — it's worth it.

situations.title: 시술 변경 재확인
situations.tagline: The plan just changed — we should run a fresh time-out for the new procedure.
situations.brief: 시술이 변경되면 재타임아웃을 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: Since the plan changed, let's re-do the time-out.
Everyone confirm the new procedure and site.
I want us all aligned before we continue.

situations.title: 검체 처리 사전 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the specimen plan now — where each sample goes and how it's labeled.
situations.brief: 검체 처리 계획을 사전에 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's clarify how each specimen should be handled.
Confirm which go to frozen and which to permanent.
I'll label and document each one carefully.
goals: 검체 처리와 라벨링 계획을 사전 확인한다

situations.title: 타임아웃 중 부위 불일치
situations.tagline: Stop — the marked site doesn't match what's on the consent.
situations.brief: 타임아웃 중 부위 불일치를 발견하면 즉시 진행을 정지시키세요.
keyPhrases: Stop everything — we have a discrepancy here.
The marked side and the consent don't match.
Nothing proceeds until this is fully resolved.
goals: 부위 불일치를 발견해 즉시 진행을 멈춘다

situations.title: 응급 타임아웃 생략 압박
situations.tagline: We don't have time for the full checklist, but we still need to confirm the critical items.
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서도 핵심 안전 항목은 반드시 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Even in an emergency, let's confirm patient and site.
Give me ten seconds for the critical checks.
Allergies and blood availability — quick confirm.
goals: 응급 압박에도 핵심 안전 항목을 확인한다

situations.title: 팀 침묵 속 오류 방치
situations.tagline: I think something's off here, and I'm going to say it even though no one else has.
situations.brief: 팀이 침묵할 때 speak-up을 실행해 오류를 드러내세요.
keyPhrases: I need to voice a concern before we go further.
I'd rather be wrong than stay quiet about this.
Can we pause and double-check together?

situations.title: wrong-site 임박 차단
situations.tagline: Stop — that's the wrong side, put the scalpel down.
situations.brief: wrong-site 절개가 임박한 순간 즉시 저지하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop — that is the wrong site.
Put it down, please — we need to re-confirm.
The mark is on the other side.

situations.title: 항생제 누락 절개 임박
situations.tagline: Hold on — the antibiotics haven't been given yet and we're about to cut.
situations.brief: 예방적 항생제 누락 상태로 절개가 임박하면 즉시 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: The prophylactic antibiotics haven't gone in yet.
Can we hold the incision until they're given?
I'm drawing it up right now — thirty seconds.
goals: 항생제 누락을 절개 전 발견해 차단한다
투여 완료 후 진행하도록 팀과 조율한다

situations.title: 타임아웃 후 상태 급변
situations.tagline: His pressure just dropped — we need to reassess before the incision.
situations.brief: 타임아웃 후 환자 상태가 급변하면 절개 전 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: His vitals just changed — let's hold the incision.
We need to stabilize before we proceed.
Give me a moment to reassess with anesthesia.
